messages.content: 你能使用 get_stock_prices 函數來檢索蘋果、微軟、亞馬遜和特斯拉分別在1週、2週、3週和1個月的時間範圍內的股價嗎？。

function.name: get_stock_prices
function.description: Retrieves stock prices for specified companies and duration. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

companies.description: List of companies to retrieve stock prices for.

duration.description: Time duration to retrieve stock prices for. E.g., '1 week', '2 weeks', '1 month', etc.

That implies retrieving for each company across those durations. We can interpret as they want to retrieve for each company for each duration. So we need to call get_stock_prices four times: once for each duration. Or we could combine all companies but only one duration per call. So we need to call get_stock_prices with companies ["Apple", "Microsoft", "Amazon", "Tesla"] and duration "1 week". Then again with duration "2 weeks", etc.

We should ask clarifying question: do they want separate calls or combined? They might want separate calls. We can ask: "您想要一次性获取所有公司在每个时间段的数据，还是需要为每个时间段单独调用函数?" But we can also proceed to call the function four times. But the instruction says we should ask clarifying question if ambiguous. It could mean: Apple for 1 week, Microsoft for 2 weeks, Amazon for 3 weeks, Tesla for 1 month. That interpretation is plausible: "分别" means respectively. So maybe they want Apple for 1 week, Microsoft for 2 weeks, Amazon for 3 weeks, Tesla for 1 month. That seems more likely.
